2607.06432.title: TILDE: TILt-based Distributional Erasure for Concept Unlearning
2607.06432.paper_summary: Concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models is critical for safe and practical deployment: with rising privacy concerns, copyright disputes, trademark constraints, and safety regulations, deployed systems must be able to suppress unwanted concepts after training. Existing methods often remove the target concept effectively, but practical unlearning also requires an equally fundamental property: the unlearned model should retain quality, diversity, and semantic coverage on benign generation. The gold standard is a retain-only model trained from scratch without the unwanted data. However, common erasure objectives do not specify which post-unlearning distribution should approximate this reference, leaving retention as an implicit consequence of the update rule. We propose TILDE, TILt-based Distributional Erasure, which formulates concept unlearning as a distributional alignment problem: the desired target is the minimum-deviation conditional distribution from the pretrained model under a forgetting constraint. This energy-tilted, anchor-free target suppresses concept-expressing images while preserving benign relative mass for each prompt. We instantiate this principle with residual $\nabla$-GFlowNet training, which learns the score correction induced by the forget energy relative to the pretrained diffusion model. Across objects, artistic styles, and characters, TILDE achieves strong forgetting while improving retention and distributional fidelity over prior baselines.
2607.06432.paper_summary_zh: 概念遺忘在文本到圖像的擴散模型中對於安全和實際部署至關重要：隨著隱私問題、版權爭議、商標限制和安全法規的增加，已部署的系統必須能夠在訓練後抑制不需要的概念。現有的方法通常能有效去除目標概念，但實際的遺忘還需要一個同樣基本的特性：被遺忘的模型應該在良性生成上保持質量、多樣性和語義覆蓋。黃金標準是一個從頭開始訓練的僅保留模型，沒有不需要的數據。然而，常見的抹除目標並未指定哪個後遺忘分佈應該接近這個參考，將保留作為更新規則的隱含結果。我們提出了TILDE，即基於TILt的分佈性抹除，它將概念遺忘公式化為一個分佈對齊問題：所需的目標是在遺忘約束下，來自預訓練模型的最小偏差條件分佈。這個能量傾斜的、無錨點的目標抑制了表達概念的圖像，同時為每個提示保留良性的相對質量。我們用殘差$\nabla$-GFlowNet訓練實現這一原則，該訓練學習了相對於預訓練擴散模型的遺忘能量所引起的分數修正。在物體、藝術風格和角色之間，TILDE在提高保留和分佈忠實度的同時實現了強大的遺忘，超越了之前的基準。
